release_notes: v1.0.8 — Fluidity & Backend overhaul. Instant startup, event-driven scan/clean progress, GPU-accelerated animations. Design tokens & real depth shadows. Differentiated Game Boost presets (eSports/Balanced/Streamer now write distinct MMCSS values and restore on disable). Parallel disk scanning with rayon. Safer cleanup skips files modified in the last 5 minutes. Adaptive metrics emitter (slows down when window is unfocused).
